rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Automated Mule Account Creation Velocity")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:account_onboarding
(application_duration_seconds<120 OR mouse_events_count=0 OR scroll_events_count=0)
| stats count as app_count dc(applicant_id) as unique_applicants values(applicant_id) as applicants
  avg(application_duration_seconds) as avg_duration min(application_duration_seconds) as min_duration
  sum(mouse_events_count) as total_mouse_events by device_fingerprint ip_address
| where app_count>3 OR (avg_duration<120 AND total_mouse_events=0)
| eval risk_level=case(app_count>10, "critical", app_count>5, "high", app_count>3, "medium")
rules.title: DL-0118: Automated Mule Account Creation Velocity (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: KYC Verification Bot Circumvention Detection
status: experimental
description: Detect automated circumvention of KYC identity verification processes: (1) liveness check submissions exhibiting synthetic face indicators such as GAN artifacts or uniform skin texture, (2) document p
logsource:
    product: banking
    category: identity_verification
    service: kyc_verification
detection:
    selection_synthetic:
        liveness_synthetic_score|gt: 0.7
    selection_lighting:
        document_lighting_mismatch: true
        selfie_lighting_mismatch: true
    selection_multi_ip:
        identity_multi_ip_count|gt: 2
        ip_geo_dispersion_km|gt: 500
    selection_automation:
        session_interaction_pattern: "automated"
        verification_attempt_count|gte: 3
    condition: selection_synthetic or selection_lighting or selection_multi_ip or selection_automation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0119: KYC Verification Bot Circumvention Detection (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Cloud Phone Behavioral Anomaly Detection")`
`comment("Detects device-environment decorrelation signals from cloud phone infrastructure")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:mobile_device_telemetry
  device_platform="android"
  battery_level=100
  accelerometer_motion_events=0
  (vpn_proxy_app_installed="true" OR vendor_management_app_present IN ("LDC Store", "LD Assistant"))
  banking_app_count>=3
| eval device_first_seen_days = round((now() - strptime(device_first_seen_date, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400, 0)
| where device_first_seen_days < 30
| eval score_battery = if(battery_level=100, 20, 0)
| eval score_motion = if(accelerometer_motion_events=0, 25, 0)
| eval score_vpn = if(vpn_proxy_app_installed="true", 15, 0)
| eval score_banking = if(banking_app_count>=3, 15, 0)
| eval score_vendor = if(isnotnull(vendor_management_app_present), 20, 0)
| eval score_newdevice = if(device_first_seen_days<30, 5, 0)
| eval cloud_phone_risk_score = score_battery + score_motion + score_vpn + score_banking + score_vendor + score_newdevice
| where cloud_phone_risk_score >= 60
| table device_id, battery_level, accelerometer_motion_events, banking_app_count,
        vpn_proxy_app_installed, vendor_management_app_present,
        device_first_seen_date, device_first_seen_days, ip_address,
        ip_geolocation, device_timezone, cloud_phone_risk_score
| sort - cloud_phone_risk_score
rules.title: DL-0179: Cloud Phone Behavioral Anomaly — Device-Environment Decorrelation Detection (SPLUNK)
